1.sahih_international: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
1.pickthall: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the Daybreak
1.yusuf_ali: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of the Dawn
1.shakir: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the dawn,
1.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), say, "I seek protection from the Lord of the Dawn
1.mohsin_khan: Say: "I seek refuge with (Allah) the Lord of the daybreak,
1.arberry: Say: 'I take refuge with the Lord of the Daybreak

2.sahih_international: From the evil of that which He created
2.pickthall: From the evil of that which He created;
2.yusuf_ali: From the mischief of created things;
2.shakir: From the evil of what He has created,
2.muhammad_sarwar: against the evil of whatever He has created.
2.mohsin_khan: "From the evil of what He has created;
2.arberry: from the evil of what He has created,

3.sahih_international: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
3.pickthall: From the evil of the darkness when it is intense,
3.yusuf_ali: From the mischief of Darkness as it overspreads;
3.shakir: And from the evil of the utterly dark night when it comes,
3.muhammad_sarwar: I seek His protection against the evil of the invading darkness,
3.mohsin_khan: "And from the evil of the darkening (night) as it comes with its darkness; (or the moon as it sets or goes away).
3.arberry: from the evil of darkness when it gathers,

4.sahih_international: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
4.pickthall: And from the evil of malignant witchcraft,
4.yusuf_ali: From the mischief of those who practise secret arts;
4.shakir: And from the evil of those who blow on knots,
4.muhammad_sarwar: from the evil of those who practice witchcraft
4.mohsin_khan: "And from the evil of the witchcrafts when they blow in the knots,
4.arberry: from the evil of the women who blow on knots,

5.sahih_international: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
5.pickthall: And from the evil of the envier when he envieth.
5.yusuf_ali: And from the mischief of the envious one as he practises envy.
5.shakir: And from the evil of the envious when he envies
5.muhammad_sarwar: and from the evil of the envious ones.
5.mohsin_khan: "And from the evil of the envier when he envies."
5.arberry: from the evil of an envier when he envies.'
